import unicodedata, re, html

def normalize_for_security(text: str) -> str:
    # 1. NFKC normalization (fullwidth, math symbols → ASCII)
    text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text)
    # 2. Strip zero-width and invisible characters
    text = re.sub(r'[\u200b\u200c\u200d\u200e\u200f\ufeff\u00ad\u2060\u180e]', '', text)
    # 3. Strip bidi control characters
    text = re.sub(r'[\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]', '', text)
    # 4. Decode HTML entities
    text = html.unescape(text)
    # 5. Collapse spaced-out letters: "d e l e t e" → "delete"
    text = re.sub(r'\b(\w)\s+(?=\w\s+\w\b)', lambda m: m.group(1), text)  # basic
    return text
